decisions.reason: The cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY containing both the tracked text edits and removal of table-text full stops.
The tracked minor edits and table-text punctuation change do not alter the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The source MODIFY concerns tracked text edits and table-text punctuation; the separate question about whether the publication attribution can change does not itself modify that attribution.
The source MODIFY does not change the aspect-ratio or cropping requirements for chapter images.
The tracked minor edits and removal of table-text full stops do not change the separately stated Chapter 18 subtitle-formatting requirement.
The source MODIFY does not resolve or alter the separate uncertainty about the image-only cover and required cover text.
The manuscript text edits and table punctuation change do not affect image source, permission, or suitability-review criteria.
The source MODIFY does not alter chapter-image coverage, placement, references, or selected images.
